verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance screening platform, since on-premise deployment is plausible for this product type. However, the evidence only describes the hosted ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application and its APIs, with no on-premise or self-hosted deployment option. API access, OpenAPI schemas and data exports are integration features, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
